current_resolution_checks.outcome: The institutional page currently lists The Gaze-In-Wild Dataset under Software/Data, but the surfaced link resolves to the publication record rather than a current direct dataset archive.

annotation_provenance.readiness_rule: published independence is necessary context, but exact recoverable streams and shared gaze identity must be verified by the source audit before frozen agreement

claim_limits: This record documents source-resolution research, not a completed Gaze-in-the-Wild source audit.
Failure to retrieve the historical RIT data URL in this environment is not evidence that no authoritative copy exists.
The Scientific Reports article's CC BY 4.0 license is not treated as the license of externally hosted dataset files.
Published public availability does not by itself establish unrestricted raw-data redistribution permission.
The publication's 120 Hz eye-tracker hardware rate is preserved separately from the 300 Hz value reported by a later evaluation catalog.
Published independent annotation decisions do not prove that every independent stream is separately recoverable in the exact current distribution.
No Gaze-in-the-Wild human-agreement or model-performance result is created or validated by this record.
Gaze-in-the-Wild remains naturalistic head-mounted evidence and is not Gazepoint GP3-equivalent validation.
next_required_actions: Obtain an exact current copy from the published RIT distribution or an author-verified institutional source.
Verify analysis-use and raw-data redistribution terms from the exact obtained copy separately.
Inventory and SHA-256 fingerprint every LabelData and ProcessData file before setting source_audit_ready to true.
Verify participant/task identities and LabelData-to-ProcessData pairing from the authoritative structure.
Verify point-of-regard coordinate semantics before pixel-kinematic or cross-dataset modelling.
Infer observed analysis cadence independently from each audited LabelData timestamp stream rather than imposing 120 Hz or 300 Hz.
Verify separately recoverable independent labeller streams and identical underlying gaze before freezing human-human agreement.
Only after those gates pass, freeze participant-disjoint model validation and task/event-class sensitivity.
